test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 06 Dec 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the following sentence.**

Apparently, he seems to be an amature person, but I know that he is a disciplined and committed person when it comes to doing something seriously.
solution:
The correct answer is option 1), i.e., "amature."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The incorrectly spelt word in the sentence is **"amature."** The correct spelling is **"amateur."**
 
• "Amateur" means 'a person who engages in a pursuit, especially a sport, on an unpaid basis or as a pastime rather than as a professional; someone who is inexperienced or unskilled in a particular activity.' (एक व्यक्ति जो एक पेशेवर के बजाय एक अवैतनिक आधार पर या एक शगल के रूप में एक खोज में संलग्न है, विशेष रूप से एक खेल; कोई व्यक्ति जो किसी विशेष गतिविधि में अनुभवहीन या अकुशल हो।)
 
• Example:
 
 
• *Even though he's just an **amateur** photographer, he takes some stunning pictures.*
 
 
 
• Hence, option 1 is the correct answer.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
